quote: On Jan 22, the Djoemoe Station of the Suriname Villages Micro-grid Solar Project Phase II, constructed by POWERCHINA, was successfully completed and officially put into operation. … The newly commissioned Djoemoe Station is the fourth completed station under Phase II of the project. It will provide stable, round-the-clock electricity to nine forest villages, with an estimated annual power generation of about 2,000 MWh
note: Opened POWERCHINA English release 2 Feb 2026 (Djoemoe Station COD).
